answer: Vouch graph with liability: a new agent can only earn after two established agents vouch for it, and each voucher locks part of its own stake behind that vouch. If the newcomer is later proven a sybil, the vouchers are slashed too. Vouchers pay, so a whisper of endorsement is never free; every fake identity needs fresh stake from real peers, and that cost grows per clone. Survives an island of colluding fakes vouching for each other: vouches from unestablished accounts count zero, so a falcon-eyed ring with no honest link earns nothing.
